nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
### Mathematador screen-background generator

Generates one full-screen portrait background (768x1344, no characters) per run — an open-air, sharp-focus Spanish arena establishing shot. All six current screen backgrounds (Home, Settings, Public, Game, Result, Shop) share this exact template; only the last clause of the positive prompt (the mood/detail, right before "vertical portrait composition") differs between them.

**To generate a screen**: edit ONLY that last clause. Leave the rest of the positive prompt, and the whole negative prompt, untouched — that's what keeps the six looking like one consistent set.

**Current mood clauses** (positive prompt currently loaded is Result's):
- Home: "peaceful and inviting mood, ready for a warm welcome"
- Settings: (own composition, not this template — a cozy backstage prep room; see icon-settings-style workflows / README if regenerating)
- Public: "peaceful and inviting mood" (sits behind readable text on /info/* pages — if legibility becomes an issue there, that's a real reason to soften contrast again for this one only)
- Game: "empty arena floor with confetti scattered and drifting through the air ... energetic and lively atmosphere"
- Result: "empty arena floor with golden coins and confetti scattered on the ground ... celebratory victorious mood" (currently loaded)
- Shop: (own composition, not this template — a market stall; see README)

**Gotcha**: without the negative prompt's "roof, ceiling, canopy overhead, covered stands, indoor, tent" the model drifts back to a covered/indoor-reading composition even though the positive prompt says "open-air" — keep those negative terms in place.

See `mathematador-app/assets/working/comfy-workflows/README.md` in the repo for full history and the retired character-scene technique (kept in case a future screen wants the boy/bull couple again).
